text:
What lives here will live longer than I,

even the starlings' nests,

and this migratory air that crossed,

spring air, the sea in flight.


Eternity's voice calls us from there,

from beyond with its invincible force,

and above the cherry tree in bloom,

the waning moonlight pours down.


It seems to whiten without hindrance,

through the green thickets,

the path I do not say where it leads...


There is more clarity among the trunks

and everything resembles the grove

that surrounds the pond in Tsarskoye Selo.

translation.title: What Lives Here Will Live Longer than I...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the survival of place, migratory air, and the remembered Tsarskoye Selo grove.
